name: -6 AN to 11/16-18 Inverted Flare Adapter
title: -6 AN to 11/16-18 Inverted Flare Adapter
description:
ColorFittings Inverted Flare Adapters are precision-engineered to connect AN flare fittings to inverted flare ports, providing a secure, leak-free solution for brake, fuel, oil, and power steering plumbing systems.

Each adapter is CNC machined from 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process for maximum strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. Designed to withstand high pressure and high temperature environments in racing, street performance, marine, and aviation applications.

Our Inverted Flare Adapters are engineered for a perfect fit and seal when paired with ColorFittings AN fittings, which are specifically designed for use with E85, ethanol-based fuels, and race fuels. Combine with the nylon or stainless steel braided hose for clean, reliable routing in any high-performance plumbing system.

For best installation results, use the AN Fitting Assembly Tools to prevent fitting damage and ensure proper alignment. Reference the installation video and fitting guide for torque recommendations.

Explore the full range of AN fittings, braided hose, and fitting assembly tools.
